chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad narrated from Umar ibn Abd al-Aziz, from al-Khaybari, from al-Mufaddal, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

If it were not that Allah created the Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him), there would be no match for Fatimah (peace be upon him) on the face of the earth except Adam, and whoever is below him.
And it is not permissible for a man to marry a woman who has been divorced three times, except according to the Sunnah; he narrated that.

key_terms.أَمِيرَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ: Commander of the Faithful (title for Imam Ali)

ai.seo_question: Who was the only suitable match for Fatimah al-Zahra (peace be upon her) according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* underscores the unique ontological status of Imam Ali (AS) as the sole perfect match (*kufu'*) for Fatimah al-Zahra (AS), affirming his superiority over all creation including Adam. It further clarifies the jurisprudential ruling that a man cannot remarry a woman who has received three divorces unless she fulfills the specific conditions of *Tahlil* (marriage to another man and subsequent divorce) according to the Sunnah, preventing the practice of *Gharar* or artificial divorce.
